derived_findings.method: Deterministic arithmetic and legal replay of stored diagnostic searches, frozen weights and previously exposed teacher receipt; no additional engine calls
interpretation: Old depth2 branch scores tie at white -51; the prior Ng4 principal move is retained by the strict greater-than replacement rule. The output head changes the same support leaves to Ng4 -43 and Bf5 -44, favoring Bf5 by one integer cp for Black.

The relative raw gap shifts only -2.2265625 cp, far smaller than the 171 cp stored teacher quality difference. 171 cp is a move-choice consequence of crossing a shallow near-tie, not a 171 cp change of the network output.

Both original and exact forced searches miss the teacher White response exf6 after Bf5, preferring Bg5. The exposed teacher line contains quiet non-check Ng5 after exf6 Bxb1, beyond the completed two-ply search and outside capture-or-check quiescence.
Teacher Ne4 is also already undervalued by the old head at depth2; merely restoring the old near-tie would not produce the teacher move.
Turning TT/PVS/LMR off preserves all six completed depth2 forced values; the reproduced regression is not explained by those heuristics. Fixed 10k-node searches do not complete full-root depth3.
Existing SF child scores are accepted exact CP receipts at depth10, but not deep independent truth. No fresh SF analysis was performed, so the numerical 171 cp uncertainty remains.
derived_findings.actionable_hypothesis: Use verified support leaves from the same default search and completed iteration as production, with MSE comparisons targeted to actual competing root choices. Keep the output-only constraint and validate transfer to fresh roots; no improvement is guaranteed by lower score or gap MSE alone.
